points.description: States 'stem flow' (water flowing down the stems/trunks and branches of the trees to the ground). The term 'stemflow' must be used.
points.partial_credit: Half only if the flow along stems/branches is described precisely but the term 'stem flow' is not named.

points.description: States 'through fall' (water dropping/falling from the leaves/canopy onto the ground). The term 'throughfall' must be used.
points.partial_credit: Half only if dripping/falling from leaves to the ground is described precisely but the term 'through fall' is not named.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both exact terms: stem flow and through fall, in either order. Each is worth 1 mark; a vague description without the term earns at most half of that point. A wrong extra term (e.g. interception loss, runoff, infiltration, evaporation) given as an answer cancels the point it replaces or sits beside. Unrelated answers earn 0.
